## Contributor checklist

- [ ] The change is in scope and normative changes have a rationale.
- [ ] Example frame identities and measurements are fictional or explicitly sourced.
- [ ] `uv run ruff check` and `uv run pytest` pass.
- [ ] `uv run obcs validate examples/*.yaml` and `uv run obcs check-generated` pass.
- [ ] Measurement provenance, units, and uncertainty are included where relevant.
- [ ] Modified versions do not claim OBCS conformance without passing the reference suite.
